how: j opens a three letter word three quarters of the time; a hush or a tooth sound closes a three letter word a quarter of the time
p, t and k open half the words they could; a voiced stop stands first in a closing cluster three quarters of the time; an even sieve keeping 3 of 5
a voiceless stop stands second in an opening cluster a quarter of the time; j closes a word opening on a cluster a quarter of the time; an even sieve keeping 4 of 5
